review_notes: Cropped metadata-clean PLOS ONE supplementary microscopy time-lapse shows H2B-GFP labeled chromosomes condensing/aligned as bright bars, separating into two groups, and resolving into daughter nuclei/cells over time. A single fluorescent cell frame may show nuclei or condensed chromosomes, but the target concept requires observing the temporal mitotic chromosome movement and segregation sequence. The source page double-checks that the movie contains control HeLa cells entering mitosis and is CC BY; the pass decision relies on visible chromosome dynamics rather than source text. The accepted derivative removes source metadata and crops out the embedded bottom timestamp band; there is no audio or answer text.
